items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: That was the time of Teo and Dublade. They had a band of the arms.

ctx.x: That's right. I was wondering more about your father now. Quite a few people will tell us about your uncle Papa, they call him, didn't they? That's right. That he played in some of the dance bands and other bands that they talk about. But very few people tell us which bands your father worked with. Did he ever do much dance work? Or a brass band?

That's right. My father, my father from the time, they were one of the greatest bands of all of them. That was the time of Teo and Dublade. They had a band of the arms. That's been a long time. Then my father. Then my father, he was a, he was a, had a band, Promo's band.
